messages:
maria-ae: FYI NovaPay asked for a compact perf POC. Needs: sustain 150 qps mixed chat+embeds for 30m, avg request ~512 tokens, 95p chat latency <300ms, and headroom to 300 qps for 2m. They want a runbook, cost sketch (hosted vs dedicated), and security answers. Can we run a smoke+stress tonight and share numbers tomorrow? @sam-se @jeff-ml

sam-se: Ill take the run. Do we have a preferred model family? open-llama-13b quant vs 70b will change everything.

maria-ae: They said something comparable to gpt-3.5 turbo; open to recommendations. Tail latencies matter more than peak QPS.

jeff-ml: For the token size, open-llama-13b-quant is a sensible baseline. 70b multiplies infra & cost ~3x. I can allocate a dedicated pool (4x A10 equiv) for tonight.

nina-sre: Sizing note: 150 qps sustained (no large batching) -> recommend min 6 nodes to keep queuing low. If we allow small batching (budget 50ms), cost drops ~20%. I'll prepare queue math and autoscale policy.

sam-se: Draft runbook:
1) Smoke (5m) 10 qps single model validate
2) Ramp (10m) linear to 150 qps
3) Sustain (30m) hold 150 qps
4) Burst (2m) spike to 300 qps, check autoscale/fallback
5) Cooldown (10m)
Load snippet:
```
# simple k6-ish harness
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 30m --env MODEL=open-llama-13b --endpoint https://redwood.test/api/generate
```
I'll capture 50/90/95/99 latencies and error rates.

olivia-sec: Two security items from their questionnaire: 1) 30-day logs retention and proof we don't train on customer data; 2) KMS key management for encrypted payloads. Both supported on Dedicated, will confirm wording. I can draft the one-pager.

maria-ae: Pricing ask: hosted per-token vs dedicated monthly ballpark so I can negotiate.

jeff-ml: Quick ballpark: hosted (open-llama-13b quant) ~ $0.015-$0.03 /1k tokens for this workload (includes burst). Dedicated: 6 nodes ~ $18k-$28k/mo list; committed discounts bring to ~$12k-$18k/mo. I'll refine after tonight's run.

nina-sre: Ops: pre-warm KV cache for burst. Autoscale min=6 max=12, warm-spare policy to spin a node ahead. Enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts. I'll add fallback policy to shift to a slightly cheaper model if 95p > 350ms.

deploy-bot: load-test started on pool: novapay-quickbench-172100. Test id lb-172100-01

sam-se: Smoke OK. After ramp (open-llama-13b-quant) interim numbers: chat 95p = 260ms, 99p = 410ms, embeddings 95p = 120ms. No errors during sustain. Logs uploaded.

maria-ae: Great. Can we capture GPU/CPU util and token/sec for cost calc?

jeff-ml: Captured metrics: GPU util ~78% sustained, token throughput ~280k tokens/min during sustain. Rough hosted equiv cost estimate ~$1.2k/day under current pricing assumptions. Dedicated amortizes lower with commit.

olivia-sec: Confirmed: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS and we can set no-training flag. Drafted secure-answer doc with links to compliance pages.

sam-se: One anomaly in the burst: first few coldstarts added ~120ms until KV warmed. Nina noted mitigation: warm spare + prefix cache.

nina-sre: I'll add mitigation and include autoscale tweaks + rollback criteria in runbook.

maria-ae: Perfect. I'll bundle runbook, costs, and sec answers and send to NovaPay tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone :rocket:
